Conduits move things between machines: FE, items, liquids, gases and heat. Conduits of the same kind join into one network; mixed tiers run at the slowest tier's speed.
Next to a machine, a conduit connects on its own, following the machine's side settings.
# The Wrench
- Right-click a conduit side: cycle Auto, Input (forced), Output (forced) and Disabled.
- Right-click the joint between two conduits to split or join them.
- Sneak-right-click a machine to pick it up with its contents.
